confidence_notes: Punta Cana price data informed the July meal, cappuccino and draft beer estimates. Cocktail and wine estimates use their prices relative to beer on a small sample of local menus. Lodging is modeled, with hostel prices especially uncertain because supply is limited. [Numbeo](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Punta-Cana), [Wise](https://wise.com/us/cost-of-living/dominican-republic/punta-cana), [Soles menu](https://nowinpuntacana.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Soles_Menu_English.pdf), [La Ceretta menu](https://nowinpuntacana.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/Laceretta-Cocktail-Menu-English-Final.pdf)
comparable_city_reasoning: Bayahíbe and Las Terrenas inform the estimates for independent lodging, with a modest premium for visitor demand around Bávaro.
